full_page.content:
1948, April 10th
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
April 10th 1948.
Joseph J. O'Donnell 1120 Lakeshore Drive Chicago, Illinois
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Bles'd be God in all His designs!
April 10th 1948. God bless you Joseph O'Donnell. - you and yours. I hope you are all well. Thanks be to God my strength seems to be coming back in pretty good shape, though rather slowly.
I hope that Fr. O'Donnell is improving by this time and that the good God may give him the needed patience. Shortly after his consecration Bishop Murphy of Saginaw met with a serious accident that put him on his back for about six months in same position. A year afterwards his condition was perfect. Thanks be to God! We'll include Fr. O'D. in our prayers.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Praised be Jesus!
